v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Psalterio secundum diem

text.la: Cantáte * Dómino et benedícite nómini eius.
text.en: Sing ye * to the Lord and bless his name.
The salvation of my countenance * and my God.

text.la: Illúmina, Dómine, * vultum tuum super nos.
text.en: May the Lord shine the light * of his countenance upon us.

text.la: Exaltáte * Regem sæculórum in opéribus vestris.
text.en: Give ye glory to him * in your works.

text.la: Laudáte * nomen Dómini, qui statis in domo Dómini.
text.en: Praise * the name of the Lord, ye who stand in the house of the Lord.

text.la: Beátus vir, qui invéntus est sine mácula, et qui post aurum non ábiit, nec sperávit in pecúnia et thesáuris. Quis est hic, et laudábimus eum? fecit enim mirabília in vita sua.
text.en: Blessed is the rich man that is found without blemish: and that hath not gone after gold, nor put his trust in money nor in treasures. Who is he, and we will praise him? for he hath done wonderful things in his life.

v.la: Iustum dedúxit Dóminus per vias rectas.
v.en: The Lord guided the just in right paths.

r.en: And showed him the kingdom of God.

text.la: Euge, serve bone * et fidélis, quia in pauca fuísti fidélis, supra multa te constítuam, intra in gáudium Dómini tui.
text.en: Well done, thou good and faithful servant; * thou hast been faithful over a few things, I will make thee ruler over many things; enter thou into the joy of thy Lord.

text.la: Deus, qui sanctum Camíllum, ad animárum in extrémo agóne luctántium subsídium, singulári caritátis prærogatíva decorásti: eius, quǽsumus, méritis, spíritum nobis tuæ dilectiónis infúnde; ut in hora éxitus nostri hostem víncere, et ad cæléstem mereámur corónam perveníre.
text.en: O God, Who, to succour the souls of the dying in their last agony, didst ennoble the holy Camillus with an extraordinary grace of charity, we beseech thee to pour into our hearts, for his sake, the Spirit of thy love, that we may worthily prevail against the enemy in the hour when we depart hence, and pass to receive a crown of glory in heaven.

title.la: Ss. Symphorosæ et Septem Filiorum Martyrum
title.en: S. Symphorosa with her Seven Sons, Martyrs

text.la: Vestri capílli cápitis omnes numeráti sunt: nolíte timére: multis passéribus melióres estis vos.
text.en: Even the very hairs of your head are all numbered: fear not therefore; ye are of more value than many sparrows.

v.en: The saints shall rejoice in glory:

r.en: They shall be joyful in their beds.

text.la: Deus, qui nos concédis sanctórum Mártyrum tuórum Symphorósæ et filiórum eius natalítia cólere: da nobis in ætérna beatitúdine de eórum societáte gaudére.
text.en: O God, who dost permit us to keep the birthday of thy holy Martyrs Symphorosa and her sons, grant that we may enjoy their fellowship in everlasting happiness.
